settings.content:
Make a little more room for yourself. Our sea moss gel brings a ready-to-use sea moss base to your everyday routine, with fruit flavors, blends and Raw Original to explore.

settings.title: Better mixed than straight
settings.text: In its Raw natural form I couldn’t swallow it. It’s not a nasty taste but definitely an acquired taste. I took a star off because i had trouble swallowing it by itself.

settings.title: Delicious flavor and smooth texture
settings.text:
I really enjoyed trying this red guava sea moss gel. The texture is smooth and easy to mix into my daily routine. The red guava flavor gives it a pleasant fruity taste without being too strong, which makes it much more enjoyable than some sea moss products I’ve tried before.

I also like that it comes in a glass jar and has a good 16 oz size. It’s easy to scoop and add to smoothies, yogurt, or other foods and drinks. The consistency is thick but not difficult to work with.

Overall, this is a nice-tasting sea moss gel with a convenient texture and attractive packaging. I’m happy with the quality and would definitely consider getting it again.

settings.title: Quality ingredients, pleasant taste
settings.text: I have no prior experience with any such product, and only time will tell whether it's doing anything good, but I can say it doesn't seem to be doing any harm. I've consumed a tablespoonful every day for the past three straight, and it's rather tasty — fresh, fruity, a bit zesty—and has a pleasant apple saucy texture. If you take it on an empty stomach, keep in mind that it contains lime juice, which can be a bit acidic for some.

settings.question: Which flavors can I explore?
settings.answer: Browse the flavor selector at the top of this page for the full selection. Pick a flavor to see its photos, current price and availability.

settings.question: Do different flavors have different prices?
settings.answer: They can. Select a flavor to see its current price and availability before adding it to your cart.

settings.question: How do I rotate the jar?
settings.answer: When your selected flavor has a 360° thumbnail, tap it and drag horizontally. You can also use the arrow controls, zoom buttons or keyboard arrows. Open View Jar Label for a flat, readable view of the printed panels.

settings.question: How should I store my jar?
settings.answer: Follow the storage directions and date information printed on the jar you receive. Contact us if you need help reading or understanding those directions.

settings.question: Are the ingredients the same for every flavor?
settings.answer: Do not assume that every flavor has the same ingredients. Select your flavor and read its printed label images, then check the label on the jar you receive before use.

settings.question: Where can I read the ingredients and jar directions?
settings.answer: Choose your flavor, then open View Jar Label where available. If your selection does not have a label view yet, contact hi@healistix.com for its details before ordering. Follow the directions on the jar you receive.
